Forme juridique de l'attributaire Le marché public sera conclu : – soit avec un opérateur économique unique ; 8/17 – soit avec un groupement d’opérateurs économiques conjoint ou solidaire. En cas de groupement conjoint, le mandataire sera solidaire, pour l'exécution du marché public, de chacun des membres du groupement, pour ses obligations contractuelles à l'égard de l’acheteur. La composition du groupement ne peut être modifiée entre la remise des offres et la date de signature du contrat. 2-6. ant indiquant qu'il ne tombe pas sous le coup d'une interdiction de soumissionner. Pour satisfaire aux obligations susmentionnées, le candidat qui envisage, dès le dépôt de son offre, de sous-traiter une partie de sa prestation, complètera utilement la déclaration de sous - traitance et joindra, pour chaque sous-traitant, l’ensemble des documents, attestations et renseignements réclamés aux candidats, tels que figurant au présent règlement de la consultation. La notification du marché public emporte acceptation du sous-traitant et agrément des conditions de paiement. Les prestations de services sont prouvées par des attestations du destinataire ou, à défaut, par une déclaration de l'opérateur économique ; • Une déclaration indiquant les effectifs moyens annuels du candidat et l'importance du personnel d'encadrement pendant les trois dernières années ; • Une description de l'outillage, du matériel et de l'équipement technique dont le candidat disposera pour la réalisation du marché public. Il est accessible en ligne, notamment via la plateforme https://dume.chorus -pro.gouv.fr ou directement depuis certains profils acheteurs sur https://www.marches-publics.gouv.fr. Grâce à ce formulaire, l’entreprise peut bénéficier d’un pré remplissage automatique de certaines informations à partir de son numéro SIRET, ce qui réduit le nombre de saisies. references_experience.text: (MVVM) development pattern, where you would have to code the presentation layer by creating View Models and Views for each object you wish to display, using NOF there is only a set of default generic (MVVM) views defined by NOF and they are applied to all domain objects (models). The Naked Objects pattern was first described formally in Richard Pawson's PhD thesis which includes a thorough investigation of various antecedents and inspirations for the pattern including, for example, the Morphic user interface. Naked Objects is commonly contrasted with the model-view-controller pattern. However, the published version of Pawson's thesis (see References) contains a foreword by Trygve Reenskaug, who first formulated the model-view-controller pattern, suggesting that Naked Objects is closer to the original intent of model-view-controller than many of the subsequent interpretations and implementations. Further information on the NO pattern is available at http://www.nakedobjects.org/ . Naked Objects 2.0 The BOMi currently uses version 2.0 of the Naked Objects framework, referred to as 'NOF2', which was the first publicly available framework to implement the 'naked objects pattern'. NOF2 was originally written by Naked Objects Group and supplied to the Department under an open-source licence.

nerklärung_Bezug_Russland-0422 Entsprechend der Verordnung (EU) 2022/576 dürfen öffentlichen Aufträge und Konzessionen nach dem 9. April 2022 nicht an Personen oder Unternehmen vergeben werden, die einen Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift aufweisen. Dies umfasst sowohl unmittelbar als Bewerber, Bieter oder Auftragnehmer auftretende Personen oder Unternehmen als auch mittelbar, mit mehr als zehn Prozent, gemessen am Auftragswert, beteiligte Unterauftragnehmer, Lieferanten oder Eignungsverleiher. Ein Bezug zu Russland im Sinne der Vorschrift besteht a) durch die russische Staatsangehörigkeit des Bewerbers/Bieters oder die Niederlassung des Bewerbers/Bieters in Russland, b) durch die Beteiligung einer natürlichen Person oder eines Unternehmens, auf die eines der Kriterien nach Buchstabe a zutrifft, am Bewerber/Bieter über das Halten von Anteilen im Umfang von mehr als 50 Prozent, c) durch das Handeln der Bewerber /Bieter im Namen oder auf Anweisung von Personen oder Unternehmen, auf die die Kriterien der Buchstaben a und/oder b zutreffen. Bereits vor dem 9. April 2022 geschlossene Verträge mit solchen Personen oder Unternehmen mit Bezug zu Russland dürfen nur bis zum 10. Oktober 2022 fortgeführt werden. ip_data_security.text: The Contracting Entity intends to procure a contract for a Service Provider to provide, licence, support and maintenance for ESB’s Digital workspace Monitoring Software. ESB operates the ControlUp monitoring software which enables us to leverage modern digital technologies to gather and analyse data at every critical point of our Digital Workspace infrastructure. It also provides historical data that is very important for recognising trends and proactively addressing issues. It is proposed that the Contract will include (non-exhaustive list – high level scope): ControlUp Performance Monitoring Software The supply of software support with licensing for the existing ESB Digital Workspace solution. Maintenance for all existing software. Management of software licences/subscriptions for all devices and software modules is required. The supply of software support with licensing for any new software added during the term of the contract. This will not be restricted to ControlUp related products as other digital monitoring solutions will be considered. As a key international institution responsible for safeguarding euro area financial stability, the ESM must provide timely, accurate, and accessible information on its activities, including bond issuances, auction results, press releases, publications, and crisis prevention/sup port mechanisms. A reliable, secure, and user- friendly website is therefore essential for maintaining market confidence, fulfilling transparency obligations, and supporting the ESM’s institutional mandate. The Communications Department leads the day -to-day management of the Website. It coordinates multiple authorised editors (the user management is taken care of the ESM Communications Department) across the organisation who publish and update content on a daily basis. While the Communications Department retains full editorial control and ownership, the ESM has multiple authorised editors who contribute on a daily basis to the Website, publishing and maintaining a wide range of content such as press releases, bond -related information, auction results, newsletters, publications, and other institutional materials. The Website is primari

d in consultation with the ESM and/or its third- party experts, and the Service Provider will not implement the TP until the ESM has confirmed its acceptance of the TP in writing (e -mail will be sufficient). The Service Provider will deliver and maintain the TP in Microsoft Project format (unless otherwise agreed with the ESM) and include a Gantt chart. The Service Provider will maintain the TP as the t ransition services progress, to identify issues, update progress achieved, and record any other matters agreed with the ESM. Scheduled updates to the TP will be at least biweekly during the transition period. Internal Use 2.1.2. Establishing a Drupal-centric cloud solution service hosting (DCCSS) The Website is currently operated on a fully functional and mature Drupal -centric cloud solution service (DCCSS) on AWS. As the Website has already been successfully upgraded to Drupal 11, no large-scale platform or infrastructure upgrades is foreseen at this stage. Instead, the focus of the DCCSS is on the continuous operation, optimisation, enhancement, and future-proofing of the ESM Website. The Service Provider will work with the Incumbent Service Provider during a transition period, not exceeding 4 months. Testija: vastutab kvaliteedikontrolli ja testimise eest (võib olla kombineeritud disaineri või projektijuhi rolliga). Pakkuja peab pakkumises esitama meeskonnaliikmete nimed ja rollid ning iga rolli kohta CV Lisa 6 vormil. Meeskonnaliikmeid võib hankelepingu täitmise ajal vahetada, kuid sellest tuleb hankijat eelnevalt teavitada. insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ents; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035-0001 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

Commissioning: Commissioning is a process that involves the entire Design Team throughout the planning, design, construction and occupancy of the project. Commissioning Guidelines for AOC Projects are contained in the policy statement of June 7, 2010. During the initial planning process, the AOC Project Team shall determine the purpose and role of commissioning. The purpose may be to ensure proper integration of a small renovation/rehabilitation into the Capitol 7 AOC Order 28-8, December 26, 2018 complex, or it may be related to a certification. It may range from simple, direct Owner commissioning by the AOC to an independent Commissioning Agent with a substantial budget. As a rule, if a project is designed by an Associate A/E, then commissioning will be performed by a third party hired by the AOC.
